en: Black‑and‑white street view showing a tram line running along a wide avenue lined with multi‑story historic buildings. Pedestrians, cyclists and early automobiles share the cobbled street. Numerous shop signs in German hang from the buildings, including cafés and dental ateliers. The caption at the bottom left reads "GRAZ. ANNENSTRASSE." and at the bottom right "W. KRAMER. 3725." The perspective looks along Annenstrasse toward the city center, with church towers visible in the distant background.
